title: Good, but has some issues
text: Good, but has some issues. I do like how the shower caddy is durable. It will last longer without rusting, an issue I've had with other types. But there are two issues with this caddy that frustrate me. One, it needs to be longer between the top shelf and the hook. My shower head almost gets in the way of that shelf so I don't even store any product there, making for a pointless shelf. Two, there needs to be more than one suction cup on the back. It doesn't stick well and tends to tilt to one side, sometimes my products tip off the bottom shelf.
